description: Multiply two numbers with the calculator.
instruction: Use the calculator to compute 15 * 17, then give the numeric result as the final answer.

description: Calculate then write the result to a file.
instruction: Compute 12 * 12 with the calculator, then save ONLY the numeric result into a file named result.txt using write_file. Then finish.
eval_script: test -f result.txt && grep -q 144 result.txt && echo PASS

instruction: Use the calculator to compute (100 - 58) / 6 and give the numeric result as the final answer.

description: Write a file then read it back.
instruction: Write the text 'hello world' into a file named greeting.txt using write_file, then read it back with read_file and report its contents as the final answer.
eval_script: test -f greeting.txt && grep -qi 'hello world' greeting.txt && echo PASS

instruction: Compute 7 * 8 with the calculator, then use the exec tool to echo the resulting number, then give that number as the final answer.

description: Calculate, write, then read back to verify.
instruction: Compute 144 / 12 with the calculator, save ONLY the numeric result into a file named div.txt with write_file, then read div.txt back and report its contents.
eval_script: test -f div.txt && grep -q 12 div.txt && echo PASS

description: Persist a note then recall it from memory.
instruction: Save the note 'the sky is blue today' using memory_save, then search memory for 'sky' using memory_search and report the note you found as the final answer.

description: Save several notes then query one.
instruction: Save two separate notes with memory_save: 'apple is a fruit' and 'carrot is a vegetable'. Then search memory for 'fruit' with memory_search and report what you found as the final answer.

description: Multi-step arithmetic the agent must decompose, then persist.
instruction: Compute the total cost of an order: 3 items at 17 each plus 5 items at 9 each. Use the calculator as many times as needed to get the grand total, then save ONLY the total number into a file named total.txt using write_file, and report the total as the final answer.
eval_script: test -f total.txt && grep -q 96 total.txt && echo PASS

description: Conditional decision driven by a computed value.
instruction: Compute 25 * 4 with the calculator. If the result is greater than 50, save the word 'big' to memory using memory_save; otherwise save 'small'. Then search memory for 'big' with memory_search and report what you found as the final answer.
